mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, address_id, total_amount, status, payment_method, shipping_status, coupon_id, discount_amount, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{addressId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{shippingStatus}, #{couponId}, #{discountAmount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET user_id = #{userId}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, status = #{status}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, shipping_status = #{shippingStatus}, coupon_id = #{couponId}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, address_id as addressId, total_amount as totalAmount, status, payment_method as paymentMethod, shipping_status as shippingStatus, coupon_id as couponId, discount_amount as discountAmount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id as userId, address_id as addressId, total_amount as totalAmount, status, payment_method as paymentMethod, shipping_status as shippingStatus, coupon_id as couponId, discount_amount as discountAmount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id as userId, address_id as addressId, total_amount as totalAmount, status, payment_method as paymentMethod, shipping_status as shippingStatus, coupon_id as couponId, discount_amount as discountAmount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
